thread:
Rowan: quick sync  need 3 tight competitive claims for next week's launch (post + webinar + battlecard). audience: infra buyers + SEs. keep each claim one short line.

Priya: propose: 1) predictable unit economics at scale; 2) reliable tail latency with automatic fallbacks; 3) single API across hosted/dedicated/private.

Diego: agree. sales wants 2 rebut bullets per claim. examples: 
- "We run infra": 'Keep control, remove ops lift & stabilize per-request economics.' 
- "API is enough": 'Simple API + production observability and private deployment options.'

Kira: benchmark note: show p50/p95/p99 plus cost per 1M tokens, include one-line methodology: '5k anonymized prompts, median 120 tokens.' avoid absolutes.

Rowan: legal flagged words like "always" and "cheapest". use comparative phrasing. Ops asked for 1 slide on graceful degradation: quantized fallback -> region reroute -> queued bursts.

ops-bot: created doc https://notion.redwood/competitive/pack-1745 (v1) :white_check_mark:

Priya: dropping two headline variants for A/B: 
A: 'Predictable price. Dependable performance.' 
B: 'One API from prototype to SLA.'

Rowan: nice. action items: Rowan  write webinar opener + headline variants (today); Diego  run 48h SE poll for rebut examples; Priya  finalize promo copy (EOD); Kira  mock chart + methodology blurb (tomorrow).

Diego: will ping with poll results. anyone have a short customer quote about cost stability drop here. :thumbsup:
